title: Birthday Paradox Simulator
description: See how likely a shared birthday is: simulate random groups and compare with the exact theoretical probability.
howto: Press Run simulation to compare simulated vs theoretical match rates.

faqs.a: 23 people form 253 pairs, and the no-match probability (364/365)×(363/365)×… drops just below 50% — so a match is likelier than not.

faqs.q: Is this about matching MY birthday?
faqs.a: No — that needs ~253 people for 50%. The paradox is about ANY two people sharing a birthday.
Yes, leap days are ignored and birthdays are treated as uniform — the standard textbook model.
